scope: completed 32 paired baseline/candidate public action and planning logs; no new world, no SQLite, no policy evaluation

comparison.gate_scope: Only supplied cases; no promotion until final independent and certificate audits

parent_reconstruction_method: Pure existing solve_state_route, max100, on logged before tasks; relocated variant uses min(original order cost minus logged fixed gain, variant solve cost), just as parent. Each reconstructed parent cost and selected task checked against archived parent proposal. All observed totals are <=2891, hence each parent solve has the full 100 expansion allowance; no adaptive total-budget branch is reached. The original complete source-dependent task service is retained in all reconstructions.
math_scope: Proxy matrix route optimality only; physical T/LB from completed independent audit, not matrix LB.

diagnosis.bounded_search_gap: Parent feasible full route is not seeded under the new objective: 18 candidate routes were worse than it, including 16 actual first-task changes. No route-optimality assertion was made for those nonexact results, but this omission is a concrete avoidable incumbent weakness.
diagnosis.proxy_bias_evidence: Case 926091210114 has 14/14 exact models and a same-proxy 9.627303 s gain at the sole first-task change, yet whole-run cost increases 280.604058 s; future region, discovery and representative exits are not frozen in reality.
diagnosis.new_bounded_mechanism_supported: Seed the already recovered parent complete feasible route as a new-matrix incumbent before 2-opt/A*, using the same budgets; guarantee only returned proxy <= parent priced in same matrix. No inference that actual episode time improves; no new evaluation here.
diagnosis.not_recommended: Do not label all losses model bias, do not label all losses search cap, do not infer performance from proxy bound/gap or prescribe broad weight/cap scans.
diagnosis.decision: Current candidate fails promotion gate; archive as an unsuccessful pilot. Any warm-start change needs a separate frozen version and new independent performance test authorized by root.
